scope: Three selected acoustic accordion clips for onset regression; no verified bayan
limitations: Both instruments are accordions. Neither primary source confirms bayan.
Clip montage labels and envelope proxy positions do not establish physical keypress timestamps.
Cellini assets are publicly exposed MP3 previews, not original download files; lossy codec may smear transients.
Source files already edited, original attack preroll unknown.
The Hohner note label D5 is retained from source filenames, not a claim of scientific pitch octave.
transforms: No start trimming, attack shaping or pitch shift. Decode/downmix/resample using ffmpeg for Cellini; see Hohner upstream manifest. Per-clip linear scaling to mono peak 0.6, 50 ms terminal fade, digital silent preroll 250 ms, zero padding.

fixtures.proxy_definition: First 5 ms RMS window exceeding 6% of peak RMS, after 250 ms added digital silence. Operational acoustic envelope estimate; not physical keypress truth.
fixtures.source_description: Author describes minor/major chords as staccato, long as sustained portion; source recordings are already trimmed. MP3 lossy preview may add temporal smearing.
